E1_v2 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (j : Fin 3),
  (∀ (l : List (Fin 4)), ∀ q ∉ L, Summable fun a => ‖iteratedPartial l (regularizedJet j [] ↑a) q‖) ∧
    (∀ (l : List (Fin 4)) (K : Set ℍ),
        IsCompact K →
          K ⊆ (↑L)ᶜ →
            TendstoUniformlyOn (fun s q => ∑ a ∈ s, iteratedPartial l (regularizedJet j [] ↑a) q)
              (iteratedPartial l (elliptic L j)) Filter.atTop K) ∧
      (∀ (l : List (Fin 4)),
          HasSumLocallyUniformlyOn (fun a => iteratedPartial l (regularizedJet j [] ↑a))
            (iteratedPartial l (elliptic L j)) (↑L)ᶜ) ∧
        TwoSidedRegularOn (elliptic L j) (↑L)ᶜ ∧
          ∀ (w : ↥L),
            ∃ U,
              IsOpen U ∧
                ↑w ∈ U ∧
                  ∃ r, TwoSidedRegularOn r U ∧ ∀ q ∈ U, q ∉ L → r q = elliptic L j q - kernelSpatialPartial j (q - ↑w)
E2_v2 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (j : Fin 3),
  ∀ q ∉ L, ∀ (w : ↥L), elliptic L j (-q) = elliptic L j q ∧ elliptic L j (q + ↑w) = elliptic L j q
def MathResearch.Fueter.elliptic : Submodule ℤ ℍ → Fin 3 → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun L j q =>
  kernelSpatialPartial j q + ∑' (a : { a // a ≠ 0 }), (kernelSpatialPartial j (q + ↑↑a) - kernelSpatialPartial j ↑↑a)
def MathResearch.Fueter.regularizedJet : Fin 3 → List (Fin 4) → ℍ → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun j l a q => kernelJet j l (q + a) - if l = [] ∧ a ≠ 0 then kernelSpatialPartial j a else 0
def MathResearch.Fueter.kernelJet : Fin 3 → List (Fin 4) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun j l => iteratedPartial (l ++ [j.succ]) kernel
def MathResearch.Fueter.iteratedPartial : List (Fin 4) → (ℍ → ℍ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => (ℍ → ℍ) → ℍ → ℍ) x iteratedPartial._f x_1
def MathResearch.Fueter.TwoSidedRegularOn : (ℍ → ℍ) → Set ℍ → Prop :=
fun f U => ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f U ∧ (∀ q ∈ U, leftOperator f q = 0) ∧ ∀ q ∈ U, rightOperator f q = 0
elliptic_iteratedPartial : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (j : Fin 3)
  (l : List (Fin 4)) {q : ℍ}, q ∉ L → iteratedPartial l (elliptic L j) q = ∑' (a : ↥L), regularizedJet j l (↑a) q
elliptic_regular_remainder : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (j : Fin 3) (w : ↥L),
  ∃ U,
    IsOpen U ∧
      ↑w ∈ U ∧ ∃ r, TwoSidedRegularOn r U ∧ ∀ q ∈ U, q ∉ L → r q = elliptic L j q - kernelSpatialPartial j (q - ↑w)
